source.text: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: [One who] dwells in [the] shelter of [the] Most High, in [the] shadow of [the] Almighty will lodge.

en.L: [The one who] dwells in the shelter of the Most High \q will lodge in the shadow of the Almighty.
en.B: Whoever makes a home under the cover of the Most High \q will spend the night in the shade of the Almighty.
en.R: The person who lives close to the God who is above all \q will rest safely in the shade of the Almighty.

fr.L: [Celui qui] habite sous le couvert du Très-Haut \q logera à l’ombre du Tout-Puissant.
fr.B: Qui fait sa demeure à l’abri du Très-Haut \q passera la nuit à l’ombre du Tout-Puissant.
fr.R: Celui qui vit tout près du Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout \q se reposera en sécurité à l’ombre du Tout-Puissant.

sw.L: [Yeye] anayekaa katika makazi ya Aliye Juu Kabisa \q atalala katika kivuli cha Mwenyezi.
sw.B: Yeyote anayejifanyia makao chini ya kifuniko cha Aliye Juu Kabisa \q atalala usiku katika kivuli cha Mwenyezi.
sw.R: Mtu anayeishi karibu na Mungu aliye juu ya wote \q atapumzika salama katika kivuli cha Mwenyezi.

es.L: [El que] habita en el refugio del Altísimo \q pasará la noche a la sombra del Todopoderoso.
es.B: Quien hace su hogar bajo la protección del Altísimo \q pasará la noche bajo la sombra del Todopoderoso.
es.R: La persona que vive cerca del Dios que está por encima de todo \q descansará segura a la sombra del Todopoderoso.

vi.L: [Người nào] ở trong nơi kín đáo của Đấng Chí Cao \q sẽ trú đêm dưới bóng của Đấng Toàn Năng.
vi.B: Ai lấy nơi che chở của Đấng Chí Cao làm chỗ ở \q sẽ được nghỉ đêm dưới bóng mát của Đấng Toàn Năng.
vi.R: Người sống gần gũi với Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn hết, \q sẽ được nghỉ ngơi an toàn dưới bóng mát của Đấng Toàn Năng.

decisions.choice: the one who dwells: anyone who trusts God
decisions.reason: The psalm has no title. It speaks first of anyone who lives under God's protection; in verse 2 one voice says "I", from verse 3 a voice speaks to "you", and in verses 14-16 God himself speaks.

decisions.choice: the Almighty: Shaddai
decisions.reason: Shaddai is an old name of God, used with Abraham (Genesis 17:1; Exodus 6:3). Its origin is uncertain; the ancient translations took it as "the Almighty".

decisions.choice: shelter and shadow: protection
decisions.reason: Shade is protection from the burning sun and from danger, as under a bird's wings (17:8; 36:8; 63:8). The verb lodge (lun) is to stay the night: even in the dark hours this person is safe.

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title ('Elyon) means: God above everything.

decisions.choice: spend the night (B); rest safely (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the sense of staying the night (m3); Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "le Tout-Puissant" for Shaddai and "le Très-Haut" for ʿElyon
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms set for El Shaddai and El Elyon. Psalm 91 is among the best-known psalms; the wording here is drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss, so it does not follow a familiar French version line by line.

decisions.choice: "makazi" (shelter) and "atalala" (will lodge, spend the night), drafted from the Hebrew
alternatives: the wording of the Swahili Union Version
decisions.reason: This psalm is widely known by heart in Swahili. The draft follows the Hebrew words for a covered shelter and for staying the night, and keeps clear of the familiar printed wording.

decisions.choice: el Todopoderoso
decisions.reason: Shaddai is an old name of God, taken by the ancient translations as "the Almighty". Spanish says "el Todopoderoso", the word used for El Shaddai in the Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Toàn Năng" for Shaddai
decisions.reason: Shaddai is the old title "the Almighty" (see the meaning decision); "Đấng Toàn Năng" is the form Vietnamese Bible readers know, and it says the same thing plainly.

source.text: אֹמַ֗ר לַֽ֭יהוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח־בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: I will say of YHWH, My refuge and my fortress, my God, I trust in him.

en.L: I will say of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "My refuge and my fortress, \q my God, I trust in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: This is what I say about {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "He is my shelter and my stronghold, \q my God, the one I rely on."
en.R: I say this about {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "He keeps me safe. He is my strong fortress. \q He is my God, and I trust {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

fr.L: Je dirai {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : « Mon refuge et ma forteresse, \q mon Dieu, je me confie en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.B: Voici ce que je dis {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : « Il est mon abri et mon rempart, \q mon Dieu, celui sur qui je m’appuie. »
fr.R: Je dis ceci {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : « Il me garde en sécurité. Il est ma forteresse solide. \q Il est mon Dieu, et j’ai confiance en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »

sw.L: Nitasema juu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Kimbilio langu na ngome yangu, \q Mungu wangu, ninamtumaini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}."
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo ninavyosema kuhusu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Yeye ni makazi yangu na ngome yangu, \q Mungu wangu, ninayemtegemea."
sw.R: Ninasema hivi kuhusu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Yeye hunilinda salama. Yeye ni ngome yangu imara. \q Yeye ni Mungu wangu, nami ninamtumaini."

es.L: Diré {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: «Mi refugio y mi fortaleza, \q mi Dios, en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} confío».
es.B: Esto es lo que digo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: «Él es mi refugio y mi baluarte, \q mi Dios, en quien me apoyo».
es.R: Esto digo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: «Él me protege. Él es mi fortaleza. \q Él es mi Dios, y confío en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».

vi.L: Tôi sẽ nói về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "[Ngài là] nơi ẩn náu của tôi và đồn lũy của tôi, \q Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi tin cậy nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Đây là điều tôi nói về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài là nơi ẩn náu và đồn lũy của tôi, \q là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, Đấng tôi nương cậy."
vi.R: Tôi nói về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thế này: "Ngài giữ tôi an toàn. Ngài là đồn lũy vững chắc của tôi. \q Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, và tôi tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

decisions.choice: I will say of the LORD: one voice answers
decisions.reason: A single speaker now confesses what verse 1 described. The preposition can also mean "to the LORD", but the words that follow speak of him ("in him"), so "of" is taken here.

decisions.choice: refuge and fortress: shelter and stronghold
decisions.reason: The first word (machseh) is a shelter to run to (46:2); the second (metsudah) is a mountain stronghold (18:3).

decisions.choice: "nơi ẩn náu" for refuge and "đồn lũy" for fortress
decisions.reason: The terms for these books keep one word for each of these pictures of safety, so that they read the same from psalm to psalm.

source.text: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: For he — he will deliver you from [the] snare of [the] fowler, from [the] plague of destructions.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} — {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, \q from the plague of destruction.
en.B: It is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who will rescue you from the bird-catcher's trap \q and from the plague that destroys.
en.R: God will save you from hidden traps, as a bird is saved from the hunter's net. \q He will save you from deadly disease.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te délivrera du filet de l’oiseleur, \q de la peste des ravages.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui t’arrachera au piège du chasseur d’oiseaux \q et à la peste qui détruit.
fr.R: Dieu te sauvera des pièges cachés, comme un oiseau qu’on sauve du filet du chasseur. \q Il te sauvera des maladies mortelles.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakuokoa na mtego wa mwindaji ndege, \q na tauni ya maangamizi.
sw.B: Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakayekuokoa na mtego wa mtegaji ndege \q na tauni iangamizayo.
sw.R: Mungu atakuokoa na mitego iliyofichwa, kama ndege anavyookolewa na wavu wa mwindaji. \q Atakuokoa na ugonjwa wa kuua.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te librará del lazo del cazador de aves, \q de la peste de destrucción.
es.B: Es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quien te rescatará de la trampa del que caza pájaros \q y de la peste que destruye.
es.R: Dios te salvará de las trampas escondidas, como se salva un pájaro de la red del cazador. \q Te salvará de las enfermedades mortales.

vi.L: Vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giải cứu bạn khỏi bẫy của người bắt chim, \q khỏi dịch bệnh hủy diệt.
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giải cứu bạn khỏi cái bẫy của kẻ bẫy chim \q và khỏi bệnh dịch chết người.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời sẽ cứu bạn khỏi những cạm bẫy giấu kín, như con chim được cứu khỏi lưới của thợ săn. \q Ngài sẽ cứu bạn khỏi bệnh tật chết người.

decisions.choice: you: the one who trusts
decisions.reason: From here to verse 13 the psalm speaks to "you", the person of verse 1, promising what God will do for whoever trusts him.

decisions.choice: the snare of the fowler: hidden danger
decisions.reason: Birds were caught with nets and traps. The picture is of danger that is hidden until it springs, like the plots of enemies (124:7; 140:6).

decisions.choice: plague of destructions: deadly plague
decisions.reason: The word (dever) is a plague or epidemic (verse 6). The ancient Greek translation read the same letters as "word" (davar), "a troubling word".

decisions.choice: God; hidden traps, as a bird is saved
decisions.reason: Readable names who acts and says what the picture means (m2).

decisions.choice: tú (the person who trusts), no deity pronoun setting
decisions.reason: From here to verse 13 the psalm speaks to the person of verse 1 as "tú". These pronouns are not God's and take no setting; the pronouns for God ("él", "su") do.

decisions.choice: "bạn" for the one spoken to, as Psalm 121:3
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks to anyone who trusts God (see the meaning decision), man or woman, young or old. "bạn" is the neutral modern word that fits anyone, as in the published Psalm 121.

source.text: בְּאֶבְרָת֨וֹ׀יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ וְתַֽחַת־כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְֽסֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: With his pinion he will cover you, and under his wings you will take refuge; a shield and a wall [is] his faithfulness.

en.L: With {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} pinions {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will cover you, and under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wings you will take refuge; \q a shield and a wall [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithfulness.
en.B: He will spread {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feathers over you, and beneath {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wings you will find shelter. \q His faithfulness surrounds you like a shield and a wall.
en.R: Like a bird with its young, God will spread {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wings over you, and you will be safe under them. \q Because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is faithful, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will protect you like a shield and a strong wall.

fr.L: De {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} plumes {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te couvrira, et sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ailes tu trouveras refuge ; \q un bouclier et un rempart, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité.
fr.B: Il étendra {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plumage sur toi, et sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ailes tu trouveras un abri. \q Sa fidélité t’entoure comme un bouclier et une muraille.
fr.R: Comme un oiseau avec ses petits, Dieu étendra {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ailes sur toi, et tu seras en sécurité dessous. \q Parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est fidèle, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te protégera comme un bouclier et un mur solide.

sw.L: Kwa manyoya {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} atakufunika, na chini ya mabawa {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} utakimbilia; \q ngao na ukuta [ni] uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Atatandaza manyoya {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu yako, na chini ya mabawa {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} utapata makazi. \q Uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unakuzunguka kama ngao na ukuta.
sw.R: Kama ndege na makinda yake, Mungu atatandaza mabawa {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu yako, nawe utakuwa salama chini yake. \q Kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwaminifu, atakulinda kama ngao na ukuta imara.

es.L: Con {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} plumas te cubrirá, y bajo {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} alas hallarás refugio; \q escudo y muralla [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fidelidad.
es.B: Extenderá {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} plumas sobre ti, y debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} alas encontrarás amparo. \q Su fidelidad te rodea como un escudo y una muralla.
es.R: Como un ave con sus polluelos, Dios extenderá {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} alas sobre ti, y estarás a salvo debajo de ellas. \q Como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es fiel, te protegerá como un escudo y una muralla fuerte.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ lấy lông cánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} che phủ bạn, và dưới cánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bạn sẽ ẩn náu; \q sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] cái khiên và bức tường thành.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ giương lông cánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} che trên bạn, và dưới cánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bạn sẽ tìm được chỗ trú ẩn. \q Sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bao quanh bạn như cái khiên và bức tường thành.
vi.R: Như chim mẹ che chở chim con, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ giương cánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra che bạn, và bạn sẽ được an toàn dưới đó. \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành tín, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bảo vệ bạn như cái khiên và bức tường vững chắc.

decisions.choice: under his wings: a mother bird's protection
decisions.reason: God is pictured as a bird sheltering its young (17:8; 36:8; 57:2; Deuteronomy 32:11; Ruth 2:12).

decisions.choice: a wall: a protecting rampart
decisions.reason: The word (socherah) is found only here. It is related to a verb meaning to go around, so it may be a wall around a person or a kind of shield.

decisions.choice: take refuge: run to for shelter
decisions.reason: The verb (chasah) is the one in 2:12 and 7:2.

decisions.choice: Like a bird with its young
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture is (m1) and names God.

source.text: לֹא־תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you will fear from [the] dread of night, from [the] arrow [that] flies by day,

en.L: You will not be afraid of the dread of night, \q of [the] arrow [that] flies by day,
en.B: You need not be afraid of the terrors that come at night \q or the arrow that speeds by in daylight,
en.R: You will not be afraid of dangers at night, \q or of arrows shot at you during the day.

fr.L: Tu ne craindras pas la terreur de la nuit, \q ni la flèche [qui] vole de jour,
fr.B: Tu n’auras pas à redouter les frayeurs qui viennent la nuit, \q ni la flèche qui file en plein jour,
fr.R: Tu n’auras pas peur des dangers de la nuit, \q ni des flèches qu’on te lance pendant le jour.

sw.L: Hutaogopa hofu ya usiku, \q wala mshale urukao mchana,
sw.B: Huna haja ya kuogopa vitisho vinavyokuja usiku \q wala mshale unaopita kwa kasi mchana,
sw.R: Hutaogopa hatari za usiku, \q wala mishale inayopigwa kwako mchana.

es.L: No temerás el espanto de la noche, \q [ni la] flecha [que] vuela de día,
es.B: No tienes por qué temer los terrores que llegan de noche \q ni la flecha que pasa veloz a plena luz,
es.R: No tendrás miedo de los peligros de la noche, \q ni de las flechas que te disparen durante el día.

vi.L: Bạn sẽ không sợ sự kinh hoàng ban đêm, \q [cũng không sợ] mũi tên bay ban ngày,
vi.B: Bạn chẳng cần sợ những nỗi kinh hoàng đến lúc đêm khuya, \q hay mũi tên vút qua giữa ban ngày,
vi.R: Bạn sẽ không sợ những nguy hiểm ban đêm, \q hay những mũi tên bắn vào bạn ban ngày.

decisions.choice: four dangers, by night and by day
decisions.reason: Verses 5-6 name four dangers in pairs, night and day, darkness and noon: there is no hour when God's protection stops. The sentence runs on into verse 6, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: the arrow: attack in battle, or sudden harm
decisions.reason: The arrow may be a real arrow or a picture of sudden harm from God or from enemies (64:8; Job 6:4).

source.text: מִ֭דֶּבֶר בָּאֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צָהֳרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: from [the] plague [that] walks in the darkness, from [the] destruction [that] devastates [at] noon.

en.L: of [the] plague [that] walks in the darkness, \q of [the] destruction [that] lays waste [at] noon.
en.B: or the disease that prowls in the dark, \q or the destruction that ravages at noon.
en.R: You will not fear sickness that spreads in the dark, \q or disasters that strike in the middle of the day.

fr.L: ni la peste [qui] marche dans les ténèbres, \q ni le fléau [qui] dévaste [à] midi.
fr.B: ni la maladie qui rôde dans l’obscurité, \q ni le fléau qui ravage en plein midi.
fr.R: Tu n’auras pas peur de la maladie qui se répand dans le noir, \q ni des malheurs qui frappent au milieu du jour.

sw.L: wala tauni itembeayo gizani, \q wala maangamizi yaharibuyo adhuhuri.
sw.B: wala ugonjwa unaonyemelea gizani, \q wala maangamizi yanayoharibu saa sita mchana.
sw.R: Hutaogopa ugonjwa unaoenea gizani, \q wala maafa yanayotokea katikati ya mchana.

es.L: [ni la] peste [que] anda en las tinieblas, \q [ni la] destrucción [que] devasta [al] mediodía.
es.B: ni la enfermedad que acecha en la oscuridad, \q ni la destrucción que arrasa al mediodía.
es.R: No temerás las enfermedades que se extienden en la oscuridad, \q ni las desgracias que golpean en pleno día.

vi.L: [hay] dịch bệnh đi lại trong bóng tối, \q [hay] sự hủy diệt tàn phá [lúc] giữa trưa.
vi.B: hay bệnh dịch rình rập trong bóng tối, \q hay sự tàn phá hoành hành lúc giữa trưa.
vi.R: Bạn sẽ không sợ bệnh tật lan ra trong bóng tối, \q hay tai họa ập đến giữa ban ngày.

decisions.choice: destruction: a deadly blow, an epidemic
alternatives: the demon of noon (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The word (qetev) is a destroying sickness or sting (Deuteronomy 32:24; Hosea 13:14). The ancient Greek translation took it as an evil spirit at noon.

decisions.choice: walks: moves about unseen
decisions.reason: The plague is pictured as a person walking about in the dark, reaching people without warning.

source.text: יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨׀אֶ֗לֶף וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: It will fall from your side a thousand, and ten thousand from your right hand; to you not it will come near.

en.L: A thousand will fall at your side, \q and ten thousand at your right hand; \q [but] to you it will not come near.
en.B: A thousand may drop beside you, \q ten thousand close by your right hand, \q yet it will not reach you.
en.R: A thousand people may die beside you, \q and ten thousand all around you, \q but the danger will not touch you.

fr.L: Mille tomberont à ton côté, \q et dix mille à ta droite ; \q [mais] de toi, il ne s’approchera pas.
fr.B: Mille peuvent s’écrouler près de toi, \q dix mille tout contre ta main droite, \q il ne t’atteindra pas.
fr.R: Mille personnes peuvent mourir à côté de toi, \q et dix mille tout autour de toi, \q mais le danger ne te touchera pas.

sw.L: Elfu wataanguka kando yako, \q na elfu kumi upande wako wa kuume; \q [lakini] kwako halitakaribia.
sw.B: Watu elfu wanaweza kuanguka kando yako, \q elfu kumi karibu na mkono wako wa kuume, \q lakini halitakufikia.
sw.R: Watu elfu wanaweza kufa kando yako, \q na elfu kumi pande zote kukuzunguka, \q lakini hatari hiyo haitakugusa.

es.L: Caerán a tu lado mil, \q y diez mil a tu diestra; \q [pero] a ti no se acercará.
es.B: Mil pueden caer junto a ti, \q diez mil muy cerca de tu mano derecha, \q pero a ti no te alcanzará.
es.R: Mil personas pueden morir a tu lado, \q y diez mil a tu alrededor, \q pero el peligro no te tocará.

vi.L: Một nghìn [người] sẽ ngã bên cạnh bạn, \q và một vạn [người] bên tay phải bạn; \q [nhưng] nó sẽ không đến gần bạn.
vi.B: Dù một nghìn người ngã gục bên bạn, \q một vạn người ngay bên tay phải bạn, \q tai họa cũng sẽ không chạm đến bạn.
vi.R: Có thể một nghìn người chết bên cạnh bạn, \q và một vạn người chết quanh bạn, \q nhưng nguy hiểm sẽ không chạm đến bạn.

decisions.choice: it: the plague or destruction
decisions.reason: "It" is the danger of verses 5-6 that strikes others down.

decisions.choice: a thousand, ten thousand: a great number
decisions.reason: The pair is a way of saying "very many" (1 Samuel 18:7).

decisions.choice: the danger
decisions.reason: Readable says what "it" is (m1).

source.text: רַ֭ק בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Only with your eyes you will look, and [the] retribution of wicked [people] you will see.

en.L: Only with your eyes will you look, \q and the repayment of the wicked you will see.
en.B: You will only watch with your own eyes \q and see the wicked paid back.
en.R: You will just watch \q as wicked people get the punishment they deserve.

fr.L: Seulement de tes yeux tu regarderas, \q et la rétribution des méchants, tu la verras.
fr.B: Tu ne feras que regarder de tes propres yeux \q et voir les méchants recevoir leur salaire.
fr.R: Tu ne feras que regarder \q pendant que les méchants reçoivent la punition qu’ils méritent.

sw.L: Kwa macho yako tu utatazama, \q na malipo ya waovu utayaona.
sw.B: Utatazama tu kwa macho yako mwenyewe \q na kuwaona waovu wakilipwa.
sw.R: Utatazama tu \q waovu wanapopata adhabu wanayostahili.

es.L: Solo con tus ojos mirarás, \q y verás la paga de los malvados.
es.B: Solo mirarás con tus propios ojos \q y verás cómo los malvados reciben su merecido.
es.R: Tú solo mirarás \q cómo los malvados reciben el castigo que merecen.

vi.L: Chỉ bằng mắt mình bạn sẽ nhìn, \q và sự báo trả cho kẻ ác bạn sẽ thấy.
vi.B: Bạn chỉ đứng nhìn tận mắt \q và thấy kẻ ác bị báo trả.
vi.R: Bạn chỉ đứng nhìn \q khi kẻ ác bị trừng phạt đúng như chúng đáng phải chịu.

decisions.choice: retribution: repayment
decisions.reason: The word (shillumah) is a payment in return: the wicked receive what their deeds have earned.

decisions.choice: only: you will be a witness, not a victim
decisions.reason: The one who trusts will see the judgment but not suffer it.

source.text: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For you, YHWH, [are] my refuge; [the] Most High you have made your dwelling place.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [are] my refuge! \q The Most High you have made your dwelling place.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, are my refuge! \q You have made the Most High your home.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one who keeps me safe! \q And you have made the God who is above all your home.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] mon refuge ! \q Du Très-Haut tu as fait ta demeure.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es mon refuge ! \q Tu as fait du Très-Haut ta maison.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui me gardes en sécurité ! \q Et toi, tu as fait du Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout ta maison.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [ndiwe] kimbilio langu! \q Aliye Juu Kabisa umemfanya kuwa makao yako.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndiwe kimbilio langu! \q Umemfanya Aliye Juu Kabisa kuwa makao yako.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe unayenilinda salama! \q Nawe umemfanya Mungu aliye juu ya wote kuwa makao yako.

es.L: ¡Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [eres] mi refugio! \q Del Altísimo has hecho tu morada.
es.B: ¡Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, eres mi refugio! \q Has hecho del Altísimo tu hogar.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres quien me protege! \q Y tú has hecho del Dios que está por encima de todo tu hogar.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, [là] nơi ẩn náu của tôi! \q Bạn đã lấy Đấng Chí Cao làm nơi ở của mình.
vi.B: Vì lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là nơi ẩn náu của tôi! \q Bạn đã lấy Đấng Chí Cao làm nhà mình.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng giữ tôi an toàn! \q Còn bạn đã lấy Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn hết, làm nhà của mình.

decisions.choice: a sudden change of speaker
alternatives: Because you have made the LORD, my refuge, the Most High, your dwelling
If you say, The LORD is my refuge, and make the Most High your dwelling
decisions.reason: The first line speaks to God ("you, LORD"), as the voice of verse 2; the second speaks again to the person addressed in verses 3-8 ("you have made"). Many read the verse as one sentence to that person, supplying words. This draft follows the Hebrew as it stands.

decisions.choice: dwelling place: home
decisions.reason: The word (ma'on) is the one of 90:1, where God is his people's home.

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title ('Elyon) means: God above everything.

decisions.choice: In the second line "tu" is the reader addressed in the rest of the psalm, not God, so it has no setting span
decisions.reason: The verse turns from the psalmist's word to God (first line) back to the one being encouraged (second line), as the English does with "you". Readable says "Et toi", as the English Readable says "And you".

source.text: לֹֽא־תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝נֶ֗גַע לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will happen to you harm, and plague not will come near in your tent.

en.L: Harm will not happen to you, \q and a blow will not draw near in your tent.
en.B: No evil will strike you; \q no plague will get close to your home.
en.R: Nothing bad will happen to you. \q No disease will come near your home.

fr.L: Le malheur ne t’arrivera pas, \q et le coup ne s’approchera pas de ta tente.
fr.B: Aucun mal ne te frappera ; \q aucun fléau n’approchera de ta maison.
fr.R: Rien de mal ne t’arrivera. \q Aucune maladie n’approchera de ta maison.

sw.L: Mabaya hayatakupata, \q wala pigo halitakaribia hemani mwako.
sw.B: Hakuna baya litakalokupiga; \q hakuna tauni itakayokaribia nyumbani kwako.
sw.R: Hakuna baya litakalokupata. \q Hakuna ugonjwa utakaokaribia nyumba yako.

es.L: No te sucederá mal, \q ni plaga se acercará a tu tienda.
es.B: Ningún mal te alcanzará; \q ninguna plaga se acercará a tu casa.
es.R: No te pasará nada malo. \q Ninguna enfermedad se acercará a tu casa.

vi.L: Tai họa sẽ không xảy đến cho bạn, \q và tai ương sẽ không đến gần lều bạn.
vi.B: Không điều ác nào giáng trên bạn; \q không bệnh dịch nào đến gần nhà bạn.
vi.R: Không điều xấu nào xảy đến cho bạn. \q Không bệnh tật nào đến gần nhà bạn.

decisions.choice: plague: a blow, a stroke of disease
decisions.reason: The word (nega') is a blow or stroke, often of disease (Leviticus 13:2-3) or of a plague sent by God (Exodus 11:1).

decisions.choice: your tent: your home
decisions.reason: "Tent" is an old word for a household (Joshua 22:4-8).

decisions.choice: home
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "tent" means (m2).

records.literal_gloss: For his angels he will command concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} angels {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will command concerning you, \q to guard you in all your ways.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} angels orders about you, \q to protect you wherever you go.
en.R: God will tell {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} angels to take care of you \q and keep you safe wherever you go.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anges, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donnera ordre à ton sujet, \q de te garder dans tous tes chemins.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donnera à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anges des ordres à ton sujet, \q pour te protéger partout où tu iras.
fr.R: Dieu dira à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anges de prendre soin de toi \q et de te garder en sécurité partout où tu iras.

sw.L: Kwa maana malaika {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} atawaagiza juu yako, \q wakulinde katika njia zako zote.
sw.B: Kwa maana atawapa malaika {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} amri juu yako, \q wakulinde kila uendako.
sw.R: Mungu atawaambia malaika {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakutunze \q na kukulinda salama kila uendako.

es.L: Porque a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ángeles dará orden acerca de ti, \q de guardarte en todos tus caminos.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dará órdenes a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ángeles sobre ti, \q para que te protejan dondequiera que vayas.
es.R: Dios les dirá a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ángeles que te cuiden \q y te mantengan a salvo dondequiera que vayas.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ truyền lệnh cho các thiên sứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về bạn, \q để gìn giữ bạn trong mọi đường lối của bạn.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ra lệnh cho các thiên sứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về bạn, \q để bảo vệ bạn bất cứ nơi đâu bạn đi.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời sẽ bảo các thiên sứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm sóc bạn \q và giữ bạn an toàn bất cứ nơi nào bạn đi.

decisions.choice: quoted at the temptation of Jesus
decisions.reason: In Matthew 4:6 and Luke 4:10-11 the devil quotes verses 11-12 to tempt Jesus to throw himself down from the temple. Jesus answers with Deuteronomy 6:16, "You shall not put the Lord your God to the test": the promise is for those who trust, not a dare.

decisions.choice: angels: messengers
decisions.reason: The word (mal'akh) means a messenger, here God's heavenly servants (34:8; 103:20).

decisions.choice: in all your ways: wherever you go
decisions.reason: "Ways" are the paths a person travels and so the whole course of life.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names who acts.

records.literal_gloss: On palms they will lift you up, lest you strike on the stone your foot.

en.L: On [their] palms they will lift you up, \q lest you strike your foot against the stone.
en.B: They will carry you in their hands, \q and you will not hurt your foot on a stone.
en.R: They will lift you up and carry you, \q so you will not even trip over a rock.

fr.L: Sur [leurs] paumes ils te soulèveront, \q de peur que tu ne heurtes ton pied contre la pierre.
fr.B: Ils te porteront dans leurs mains, \q et ton pied ne se blessera pas contre une pierre.
fr.R: Ils te soulèveront et te porteront, \q pour que tu ne trébuches même pas sur un caillou.

sw.L: Juu ya viganja [vyao] watakuinua, \q usije ukajikwaa mguu wako kwenye jiwe.
sw.B: Watakubeba mikononi mwao, \q nawe hutaumiza mguu wako kwenye jiwe.
sw.R: Watakuinua na kukubeba, \q hata usijikwae kwenye mwamba.

es.L: En [sus] palmas te levantarán, \q para que no golpees tu pie contra la piedra.
es.B: Te llevarán en sus manos, \q y no te lastimarás el pie con ninguna piedra.
es.R: Te levantarán y te llevarán, \q para que ni siquiera tropieces con una piedra.

vi.L: Trên lòng bàn tay [họ], họ sẽ nâng bạn lên, \q kẻo chân bạn vấp vào đá.
vi.B: Các thiên sứ sẽ đỡ bạn trên tay, \q để chân bạn không bị thương vì vấp đá.
vi.R: Họ sẽ nâng bạn lên và mang bạn đi, \q để bạn không vấp phải dù chỉ một hòn đá.

decisions.choice: quoted with verse 11
decisions.reason: Matthew 4:6 and Luke 4:11 quote this verse with verse 11 (see there).

decisions.choice: strike your foot against a stone: the smallest harm on the road
decisions.reason: Stony paths made stumbling a common danger (Proverbs 3:23). Not even a small mishap will be allowed.

decisions.choice: not even
decisions.reason: Readable brings out that this is the least of dangers (m2).

source.text: עַל־שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: On lion and cobra you will tread; you will trample young lion and serpent.

en.L: On lion and cobra you will tread; \q you will trample young lion and serpent.
en.B: You will walk over lions and cobras; \q you will crush young lions and serpents under your feet.
en.R: You will walk on lions and poisonous snakes. \q You will crush strong lions and serpents under your feet.

fr.L: Sur le lion et le cobra tu marcheras ; \q tu fouleras le lionceau et le serpent.
fr.B: Tu marcheras sur les lions et les cobras ; \q tu écraseras sous tes pieds les jeunes lions et les serpents.
fr.R: Tu marcheras sur des lions et des serpents venimeux. \q Tu écraseras sous tes pieds des lions puissants et des serpents.

sw.L: Juu ya simba na nyoka wa sumu utakanyaga; \q utamkanyaga mwanasimba na joka.
sw.B: Utatembea juu ya simba na nyoka wa sumu; \q utawaponda wanasimba na majoka chini ya miguu yako.
sw.R: Utatembea juu ya simba na nyoka wenye sumu. \q Utawaponda simba wenye nguvu na majoka chini ya miguu yako.

es.L: Sobre león y cobra pisarás; \q hollarás al leoncillo y a la serpiente.
es.B: Caminarás sobre leones y cobras; \q aplastarás bajo tus pies a leones jóvenes y serpientes.
es.R: Caminarás sobre leones y serpientes venenosas. \q Aplastarás bajo tus pies a leones fuertes y a serpientes.

vi.L: Bạn sẽ bước trên sư tử và rắn hổ mang; \q bạn sẽ giày đạp sư tử con và con rắn.
vi.B: Bạn sẽ đi trên sư tử và rắn hổ mang; \q bạn sẽ giẫm nát sư tử tơ và rắn độc dưới chân.
vi.R: Bạn sẽ bước đi trên sư tử và rắn độc. \q Bạn sẽ giẫm nát sư tử mạnh mẽ và rắn dữ dưới chân.

decisions.choice: lion, young lion: two words for lions
decisions.reason: The first word (shachal) is a poetic word for a lion (Job 4:10); the second (kefir) is a young lion in its full strength.

decisions.choice: cobra and serpent: deadly snakes
decisions.reason: The first word (peten) is a poisonous snake (58:5). The second (tannin) is a snake (Deuteronomy 32:33) or a great sea creature (74:13). Here, beside the cobra, it is a snake.

decisions.choice: trampling snakes: Luke 10:19
decisions.reason: Jesus gives his followers authority "to tread on snakes and scorpions" (Luke 10:19), which recalls this verse.

source.text: כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי־יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Because on me he has set his love, I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he knows my name.

en.L: "Because {{gender:they have|he has}} set {{gender:their|his}} love on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will deliver {{gender:them|him}}; \q I will set {{gender:them|him}} on high, because {{gender:they know|he knows}} {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.B: "Those who cling to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with love I will rescue; \q I will lift them high out of reach, because they know {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.R: "I will save those who love {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I will keep them safe and out of reach, because they know who I am.

fr.L: « Puisqu’il s’est attaché à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je le délivrerai ; \q je le placerai en haut, car il connaît {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.
fr.B: « Ceux qui s’attachent à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} avec amour, je les délivrerai ; \q je les mettrai en sûreté, hors d’atteinte, car ils connaissent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.
fr.R: « Je sauverai ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}aiment. \q Je les garderai en sécurité, hors d’atteinte, parce qu’ils savent qui je suis.

sw.L: "Kwa sababu ameweka upendo wake {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, nitamwokoa; \q nitamweka juu, kwa sababu analijua jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.B: "Wale wanaoshikamana {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} kwa upendo nitawaokoa; \q nitawainua juu wasifikiwe, kwa sababu wanalijua jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.R: "Nitawaokoa wale wanaonipenda. \q Nitawalinda salama mahali pasipofikika, kwa sababu wanajua mimi ni nani.

es.L: «Porque en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} ha puesto su amor, yo lo libraré; \q lo pondré en alto, porque conoce {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.B: «A los que se aferran a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} con amor, yo los rescataré; \q los pondré en alto, fuera de peligro, porque conocen {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.R: «Salvaré a los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} aman. \q Los protegeré y los pondré fuera de peligro, porque saben quién soy yo.

vi.L: "Vì người ấy đã đặt tình yêu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu người ấy; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt người ấy lên nơi cao, vì người ấy biết danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: "Ai gắn bó với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng tình yêu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nâng họ lên cao, ngoài tầm nguy hiểm, vì họ biết danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: "Ta sẽ cứu những ai yêu mến {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta sẽ giữ họ an toàn ở nơi không gì chạm tới được, vì họ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là ai.

decisions.choice: God himself speaks
decisions.reason: In verses 14-16 the speaker is God ("I will deliver him"), answering the trust of verses 1-2. The Hebrew does not say "says the LORD"; the change of voice shows it.

decisions.choice: set his love on me: cling to me with desire
decisions.reason: The verb (chashaq) means to be bound to someone in love (Deuteronomy 7:7; 10:15, of God's love for Israel).

decisions.choice: knows my name: knows who I am and trusts me
decisions.reason: To know God's name is to know him as he has made himself known, and to trust him (9:11).

decisions.choice: set on high: put out of reach of danger
decisions.reason: The verb (sagav) is the one behind "high fortress" (9:10; 20:2).

decisions.choice: they, them (with "he", "him" as the alternative at Literal); those who (B, R)
decisions.reason: God speaks of anyone who loves him, the person of verse 1, so Literal gives inclusive wording by default with the traditional singular as the alternative, and Balanced and Readable use the plural.

decisions.choice: no gender setting at Literal: "il", "le" for the one God speaks of, ordinary generic French
alternatives: a span on each pronoun, as the English has
decisions.reason: French puts the gender setting on nouns only; the generic "il" referring back to anyone who loves God is ordinary French. Balanced and Readable say "ceux qui", plural, as the English Balanced and Readable say "those who".

decisions.choice: no gender span: "ameweka", "nitamwokoa" at Literal, plural "wale" at Balanced and Readable
alternatives: a gender span on the pronoun
decisions.reason: Swahili verb prefixes for a person have no gender, so the Literal singular already includes anyone; Balanced and Readable say "those who", as the English does.

decisions.choice: lo, él (generic singular), with no gender setting
alternatives: los, ellos with a gender setting
decisions.reason: God speaks of anyone who loves him. The English Literal uses "they" with "he" as the alternative; Spanish Literal keeps the Hebrew singular, and generic "él" and "lo" already take in women and men, so no setting is needed. Balanced and Readable use the plural, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "người ấy" (L), "họ" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: God speaks of anyone who loves him (see the meaning decision). "người ấy" and "họ" already include men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the English gender setting to switch to; God says "Ta", with the deity_pronoun setting.

records.literal_gloss: He will call me and I will answer him; with him I [will be] in trouble; I will rescue him and honor him.

en.L: {{gender:They|He}} will call {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will answer {{gender:them|him}}; \q I [will be] with {{gender:them|him}} in trouble; \q I will rescue {{gender:them|him}} and honor {{gender:them|him}}.
en.B: They will cry out to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will answer; \q in their distress I will stand by them; \q I will free them and bring them honor.
en.R: When they call to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will answer. \q When they are in trouble, I will be right there with them. \q I will save them and honor them.

fr.L: Il {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appellera, et je lui répondrai ; \q je [serai] avec lui dans la détresse ; \q je le délivrerai et je le glorifierai.
fr.B: Ils crieront vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je répondrai ; \q dans leur détresse je me tiendrai près d’eux ; \q je les libérerai et je leur donnerai l’honneur.
fr.R: Quand ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelleront, je répondrai. \q Quand ils seront en difficulté, je serai là, tout près d’eux. \q Je les sauverai et je les honorerai.

sw.L: Ataniita, nami nitamjibu; \q [nitakuwa] pamoja naye katika taabu; \q nitamwokoa na kumheshimu.
sw.B: Watanililia, nami nitawajibu; \q katika dhiki yao nitasimama pamoja nao; \q nitawaweka huru na kuwapa heshima.
sw.R: Wanaponiita, nitawajibu. \q Wanapokuwa katika taabu, nitakuwa pale pale pamoja nao. \q Nitawaokoa na kuwaheshimu.

es.L: Él {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} invocará, y yo le responderé; \q con él [estaré] yo en la angustia; \q lo rescataré y lo honraré.
es.B: Clamarán a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo les responderé; \q en su angustia estaré a su lado; \q los libraré y los honraré.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamen, les responderé. \q Cuando estén en problemas, yo estaré allí con ellos. \q Los salvaré y los honraré.

vi.L: Người ấy sẽ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời người ấy; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [sẽ ở] với người ấy trong lúc gian nan; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải thoát người ấy và làm cho người ấy được tôn trọng.
vi.B: Họ sẽ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời; \q trong cơn hoạn nạn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở bên họ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải thoát họ và ban cho họ vinh dự.
vi.R: Khi họ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trả lời. \q Khi họ gặp khó khăn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở ngay bên cạnh họ. \q Ta sẽ cứu họ và làm cho họ được tôn trọng.

decisions.choice: honor: give weight and standing
decisions.reason: The verb (kaved) means to make weighty: God will give the one who trusts him honor before others (1 Samuel 2:30).

decisions.choice: with him I will be: God's presence
decisions.reason: The promise is not that trouble will never come, but that God will be there in it (23:4).

records.literal_gloss: [With] length of days I will satisfy him, and I will show him my salvation.

en.L: [With] length of days I will satisfy {{gender:them|him}}, \q and I will let {{gender:them|him}} see {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} salvation."
en.B: I will give them their fill of long life \q and show them {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} saving help."
en.R: I will let them live a long and full life, \q and they will see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} save them."

fr.L: [De] longueur de jours je le rassasierai, \q et je lui ferai voir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut. »
fr.B: Je les comblerai d’une longue vie \q et je leur montrerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut. »
fr.R: Je leur donnerai une vie longue et pleine, \q et ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verront les sauver. »

sw.L: [Kwa] wingi wa siku nitamshibisha, \q na nitamwonyesha wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.B: Nitawashibisha maisha marefu \q na kuwaonyesha msaada {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} uokoao."
sw.R: Nitawapa maisha marefu na yenye kuridhisha, \q nao wataniona nikiwaokoa."

es.L: [Con] largura de días lo saciaré, \q y le haré ver {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} salvación».
es.B: Les daré una vida larga y plena \q y les mostraré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ayuda salvadora».
es.R: Los dejaré vivir una vida larga y plena, \q y verán cómo yo los salvo».

vi.L: Ta sẽ cho người ấy no đủ [với] những ngày dài lâu, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho người ấy thấy sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Ta sẽ cho họ được sống lâu thỏa nguyện \q và cho họ thấy ơn giải cứu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Ta sẽ cho họ được sống lâu và trọn vẹn, \q và họ sẽ thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giải cứu họ."

decisions.choice: my salvation: my rescue
decisions.reason: The word (yeshu'ah) is deliverance from danger, what God does to save (3:9).

decisions.choice: satisfy with length of days: a full, long life
decisions.reason: To be satisfied with days is to live long and be content (Genesis 25:8; Job 42:17).
